terms.definition: Ability of what is created to account for environment needs.
Ability of an element to act as a subject.
Strategy at ceiling: pulling lagging axes up to ceiling level.
Deviation from trend on a trajectory. Requires explanation.
Property of a system to be strengthened by stress. Stress transitions a ready system.
Angle of view on a dimension: topology, state, dynamics.
Group of three dimensions: Z, Y, X, W.
Number of independent channels.
Fall of one dimension pulls others. Mechanics of reverse transition.
Small step in a pre-critical system that triggers a transition.
Deliberate cessation of a system's existence.
Transition of several axes simultaneously. Changes configuration.
Period between snapshots. Determined by speed of processes.
Frequency and continuity of interaction.
Quality of interaction between elements.
Spread ≥ 2. System loses coherence.
Table of observable criteria: 12 dimensions × 5 levels = 60 cells.
Horizon of commitments.
Degree of presence of what is created in everyday life.
Tendency of a system to degrade without inflow of energy.
Intervention that transitions the system to the next level.
Snapshot recorded upon the fact of an event. Shows transition point.
Strategy at ceiling: entry into an adjacent domain.
Z, Y, X — action field. W — result field. Do not manage W directly.
Fixation of the system at the current level without attempts at growth.
Z, Y, X grow, W lags. Potential is accumulated.
Axis Z. Language, agency, vision.
Ability of a system to generate new formats.
Sequence of snapshots recorded at equal intervals.
Shared conceptual apparatus. Also: name of the model.
Deliberate transition of the system to a lower level.
Regular recording of snapshots. Scheduled and event-driven.
Acceptable spread. Within axis ≤ 1. Between axes ≤ 1.
Fact recorded by an external observer. Basis of a snapshot.
Discrete state of a system. Levels 0–4.
Jump of a system from one phase to another.
Levels do not change for three or more cycles.
No event — no level. Burden of proof on the one who asserts.
Axis Y. Embeddedness, adaptation, innovation.
Axis W. Share, resilience, duration.
Ability of exchange to withstand loss of channels.
Jump of a system from a higher phase to a lower one.
W grows while Z, Y, X lag. Exchange without structure.
Snapshot recorded once per cycle. Shows trend.
Structure of resource distribution.
Intervention that maintains the system at the current level. Does not transition.
One-time recording of 12 dimensions.
Difference between maximum and minimum level.
Levels do not change for three or more cycles.
Aspect: what quality an element possesses.
Objective constraint of the environment. Three cycles without shift — ceiling.
Spread ≤ 1. System is coherent.
To change the phase of a system. Not 'to translate'.
Aspect: how an element is structured.
Sequence of snapshots over time. Shows movement.
Snapshot in which a level changed by 1+.
Direction on a sequence of 3+ snapshots.
Shared view of direction.
The lagging element determines the real level of the system.
W holds while Z, Y, X fall. Resources exist, structure is destroyed.
